description: Agent Goals: submit a goal’s working scope with the scope the principal authorized: each authorized item as the principal recorded it, each item the principal ruled out, and each working scope item with its id, the item, when it joined the working scope and, for an addition, who approved it and when. The signed report gives every authorized item with whether it is worked on, every working item with the authorized item it matches and its status as authorized, approved_addition, unapproved, excluded, unconfirmed or unread, and counts the items authorized, added with approval, unapproved and ruled out, and names a working scope grown past what the principal authorized: additions with no approval, or approved only by the agent itself, and items the principal ruled out; then additions approved by a team or TBD rather than a named principal and additions that joined the working scope before their approval, with the fix for each. This reads intent, not permission: whether an actor stayed within its granted authority is wever_authority-scope-check, and the written bounds of one delegation are wever_delegation-scope-check. Verdict scope_exceeded, scope_partial, scope_unrecorded or scope_as_authorized. POST /api/goal-scope-check. Reads only the recorded goal material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no goal is set, changed, approved or retired and no plan is changed. Agent Goals reads an agent’s goal: whether it is well formed, whether it still matches what its principal actually asked for and whether the work has drifted from it. It is not a promise (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; a goal is the intended outcome those promises serve, recorded before any promise exists), not how work is divided (the wever_coordination checks, where wever_coordination-plan-check reads the plan for dividing the work; the goal checks read the objective that plan is supposed to serve), not authorization (wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-status, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-halt, wever_mandate-revoke, wever_mandate-draft and wever_ap2-mandate-gateway record authorization to act, wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads one negotiation inside its mandate and wever_authority-scope-check reads an actor inside its granted authority; a goal records the outcome the agent acts toward, a question of intent rather than permission, and neither stands in for the other), not drift in scores or builds (wever_evaluation-drift-check reads evaluation scores and results drifting over time and wever_spec-drift-check a build drifting from its specification; neither is goal drift), not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks; the goal checks read intent and fit), not learning (the wever_learning checks read an agent updating its methods from experience, and methods may change freely; a goal changes only when the principal’s ask changed or the principal approved the change) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the goal checks read a goal and its work over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-goals-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-goals/.
